notes.title: New Version 0.5!!
notes.notes:
This version is very much still a work in progress, but there are some big changes I wanted to put out into the world (especially before this game premiers in a festival next week). 

Big Changes:
[olist]
[*]HERDING: Herding has been overhauled! Your sheep no longer move away from you as you get close. Instead they will flock to you and follow you (occasionally stopping as they get distracted). I think this opens up the game to lean more into exploration which I'm excited to pursue.
[*]EXPLORATION: In the meadow and snow region, the landscapes are far more populated with environment than they were before! I've added new trees, abandoned wagons, grass, and other stuff you might encounter in the world. This is my first pass at exploring how to make each environment more interesting and playing around with procedural generation more than I have ever done previously. I am already cooking up all sorts of new environments and events to include in a future update
[/olist]

I see this update as a stepping stone towards this game really finding itself, if you're familiar with what the game used to be and give this new version a try I'd love to know if you think I'm onto something!

notes.title: Patch Notes: V0.3.2.1
notes.notes:
[h1]Devlog Update - Version 0.3.2.1
[/h1]
We've been hard at work addressing some pesky bugs and making tweaks to improve your adventures. Here's what's new in the latest update:

[h2]Bug Fixes:
[/h2]BUG: Harvest/Timewarp blacked out spell icons, causing confusion.
BUG: Clicking escape didn't close the tarot UI.
BUG: Freeze spell going off in transition regions.
BUG: Powerup UI occasionally showing blank icons and defaulting all decks to warrior deck.
BUG: Pressing TAB during an egg scene paused the game without opening the tab menu.
BUG: Egg event not spawning properly.
BUG: Hatching a sheep egg didn't save to your herd properly.
BUG: Crates were overlapping each other.
BUG: Spell orbs hitting dead spiders and bouncing around the scene.
BUG: Potion of strength description had overlapping last words.
BUG: Tarot vendor slots were messed up in lava transitions.
BUG: Cloud spell almost crashed the game when the farm scene loaded.
BUG: Seed shown as "Hay Seed".
BUG: Infinite money hack when buying and selling the treasure powerup.
BUG: Farm mana not updating with levels passed outside.

[h2]Tweaks & Improvements:
[/h2]Tweaked: Changed egg displayed message to "Sheep Egg" instead of "Shegg".
Tweaked: Disabled teleport, freeze, and gravity reload on sprint.
Tweaked: Descriptions for spells including Cocoon, Lasso, Shield, Freeze, Fire, Polymorph, Gravity, and Teleport.
Added: Pop-up text when stunned and petrified for better feedback.
Added: Manual ignition support to fireworks for more control.
Improved: Coin purses are now clickable for easier access.
Improved: Foragable hitbox made more forgiving.
Improved: Wool now gives more gold.
Improved: Added variable gold amounts per crop for a more dynamic economy.
Improved: Added ">" symbol to inventory HUD for clarity.
Improved: Leaving the herd scene without collecting the basket now auto adds basket wool to player cash.
Tweaked: Magic butterfly now interacts with enemy hitbox instead of collider.

We hope these updates enhance your farming and magical adventures! As always, thank you for your feedback and support. Happy farming!

Stay tuned for more updates and magical surprises in the future!
